openingMessages.text: Morning team! Stakeholders want a shippable dashboard by Friday. We've been scoping it for weeks — can we make it happen?
It's doable... but the data layer isn't ready. We'd be hardcoding some values and skipping test coverage.
I'm still about 40% through the designs. Some screens aren't finished. 😬
CEO is presenting to investors Friday morning. We need something to show. What are we doing?

choices.label: Ship it Friday
choices.subtext: We'll clean it up in the next sprint.

followUpMessages.text: Love it. Stakeholders are going to be thrilled. 🔥
Alright. I'll open a ticket for the cleanup work. ...There are going to be a lot of tickets.
Shipping what I have. Fingers crossed the unfinished screens don't come up in the demo. 🤞

choices.label: Push to next sprint
choices.tagline: Said no when it mattered. Paid a social cost.

followUpMessages.text: Better than shipping something we'll be untangling for the next six months.
I'll tell the CEO. This is going to be a fun conversation. 😐

choices.label: Reduce scope
choices.subtext: Ship the core feature only. Cut the rest.
choices.tagline: Found the middle path. Nobody was thrilled.

followUpMessages.text: Smart. I'll reset stakeholder expectations. Less impressive but real.
I can finish the core screens today. The edge case screens can wait. 👍
This I can actually build properly. Mostly.
